name: svg-french-press-claude-sonnet-5.5-s1-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 1000" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">

</g>

<g font-size="15" fill="#222" stroke="none">
<g stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"><line x1="432" y1="70" x2="580" y2="70"/><line x1="535" y1="132" x2="580" y2="132"/><line x1="406" y1="300" x2="580" y2="300"/><line x1="508" y1="480" x2="580" y2="480"/><line x1="508" y1="555" x2="580" y2="555"/><line x1="508" y1="640" x2="580" y2="640"/><line x1="590" y1="800" x2="620" y2="800"/><line x1="290" y1="820" x2="170" y2="820"/><line x1="285" y1="932" x2="170" y2="932"/></g>
